about: v2 budget lines from PLAN_V2.md section 10 (approved 9 Nov 2026). Caps are in US dollars and add up to at most the owner's cap. Changing a cap is the owner's decision (research/v2/DECISIONS.md). Spec: v2/docs/specs/ledger.md.

phase0_foundation.what: folders, build graph, data, scene, checks, specs: no GPU

phase1_code_layers.what: code layers 1-4, 8-12, 14-15 and the compositor on the test area: no GPU

phase2_bakeoff.what: A ($0), B (~$3-5 materials + test landmarks), C (~$8-12 unshadowed style training + test area)

phase3_lock_look.what: palette/grade/ink tuning, code vs AI night and golden hour, landmark portraits if B/C

phase4_city.what: production for the commune, 10% pilot first; by winner: A $0, B ~$10-20, C ~$40-60

phase5_launch.what: R2 storage and transfer for the launch month (then ~$1-3/month, a running cost)

reserve_usd_note: 100 - 88 = 12 dollars unallocated; spending it needs a new line from the owner
